Group revenue FY26: £12,662m (+10.5% YoY); regional split NA £4,779m, Europe £4,246m, UK £3,110m, Asia Pacific £527m (totals reconcile to group revenue) (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Organic revenue growth +2.1% at constant FX (4.2% from new stores, −2.1% LFL); total constant-FX growth 11.7% including 9.8% from Hibbett and Courir acquisition annualisation (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Adjusted metrics FY26: operating profit £787m (−12.8% YoY); profit before tax and adjusting items £852m (−7.7%); operating margin before adjusting items after interest on lease liabilities 7.0% (−120 bps); adjusted basic EPS 11.71p (−5.5%) (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Statutory basic EPS FY26: 8.63p (−9.2% YoY); statutory PBT/PBT before tax, statutory operating profit, net income and adjusting-items breakdown not disclosed in this extract (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).
Gross margin FY26 47.0%, flat YoY; 30 bps price investment (particularly online) offset by higher marketing contributions (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).
Apparel sales penetration 30% (footwear/apparel revenue split not quantified); online 21% of sales (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Cash KPI change: Group updated headline KPI from operating cash flow net of lease repayments to free cash flow; full definition referenced on page 33 (not in extract) (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).
FY26 free cash flow (company KPI definition): £462m (+36% YoY); operating cash flow described as over £1.3bn (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Balance-sheet metrics cited qualitatively: net leverage 1.4x; net cash excluding leases £311m (OCR: 'E3tIm'); cash, financial debt and IFRS 16 lease liability amounts not in extract (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Shareholder returns FY26: £200m share repurchases completed; proposed total dividend 1.20p/share (final 0.87p vs FY25 final 0.67p; FY25 total 1.00p); additional £200m buyback announced February 2026 to complete in FY27; dividend cash paid and shares cancelled not stated (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Hibbett (acquired 2024) and Courir annualisation contributed 9.8% to revenue growth; NA back-office synergies post-Hibbett cited; Courir operates 311 stores in Europe (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Operational themes: Heerlen DC automation for Europe; further investment in technology infrastructure and cyber security; AI-enabled commerce referenced (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

Medium-term guidance (not FY27 numerical trading update): organic revenue ahead of ~2–3% market; space growth ~2–3% of revenue; capex trending to 3–3.5% of revenue; ~70% capex in NA and Europe; Europe target high-single-digit operating margin; profit growth ahead of revenue over medium term (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).

FY27 outlook (Chair): qualitative only—expects continued challenges/uncertainty but remains highly cash generative and confident in resilience; no August 2026 trading-update numbers (source_path: .../ch_01888425_MzUzNTk3NjU1MGFkaXF6a2N4.txt).
